0d23ee58a95722e7.description: About Clinique La Prairie and the Role Clinique La Prairie, established in 1931 in Montreux, Switzerland, is an internationally recognized destination for health and longevity programs, delivered with luxury Swiss hospitality. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and manage the food and beverage program for the All Day Dining bar, Juice Bar, and Tea Lounge, based on the CLP Longevity Bar Handbook and adapted to the AMAALA context. Create signature non-alcoholic beverages and pairings, including functional shots, infused waters, fermented drinks, mocktails, and smoothies. Develop a distinctive tea program combining international wellness teas with Saudi and Arabian herbal heritage. Curate water and coffee programs, including premium water selection and barista standards. Extend the food and beverage program to all F&B touchpoints without dedicated beverage staff, such as Room Service, Beach Club, and in-room amenities. Build the storytelling for each food and beverage item, integrating local and regional ingredients where appropriate and validated. Ensure all food and beverage offerings are compatible with CLP programs and translate into clear, appealing options for guests, validated by the Nutrition team. Identify, source, and qualify specialist suppliers in coordination with Procurement, managing regional and international supply plans. Experience with non-alcoholic beverage programs, including functional and fermented drinks. Proven ability to manage supplier relationships and complex supply chain logistics. Strong leadership skills with experience in team management and training. Understanding of operational excellence, including SOP development, quality audits, and food safety standards (HACCP). 0d88e868aa28c2ae.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة معين للموارد البشرية عن مراقب مالي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان الامتثال المالي وتدقيق العمليات والإجراءات المتعلقة بالإنفاق. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمهنيين الطموحين في بداية مسيرتهم المهنية. الغرض من الوظيفة يتولى المراقب المالي مسؤولية مراقبة وتدقيق العمليات المالية وإجراءات الإنفاق داخل الجهة المعنية. يشمل ذلك التحقق من امتثال المستندات المالية للأنظمة والقوانين، وإجازتها للصرف، بالإضافة إلى حصر مخالفات الإنفاق والمشاركة في لجان التحقيق عند الضرورة. يساهم الدور في إعداد التقارير المتخصصة وتقديم التوصيات لتحسين الرقابة المالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراقبة وتدقيق العمليات المالية وإجراءات الإنفاق المالي في الجهة المعنية. التأكد من توافر المخصصات في الموازنة المعتمدة في البند الخاص بمحتوى المستندات المالية ومدى التزامها بالقوانين والأنظمة. إجازة المستندات للصرف بعد التحقق من امتثالها للشروط المالية والقانونية. إعداد وتقديم بيانات مخالفات الإنفاق مع الأدلة الداعمة. المشاركة في لجان التحقيق في حالات العجز أو الاختلاس أو المنازعات بشأن المبالغ المالية المستحقة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالرقابة المالية، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الرقابة المالية أو التدقيق. فهم جيد للأنظمة والقوانين المالية. القدرة على تحليل المستندات المالية والتحقق من صحتها. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية ودقة في العمل. القدرة على إعداد التقارير المالية المتخصصة. مهارات تواصل فعالة للتعامل مع مختلف الأطراف. الالتزام بالمعايير المهنية والأخلاقية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل المراقب المالي ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في تعزيز الشفافية والامتثال المالي للشركة.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to use adoption, campaign, customer, operational, and platform data to guide prioritisation. Ability to manage competing priorities, cross-domain dependencies, and complex multi-vendor delivery environments. Excellent communication, facilitation, negotiation, and decision-making skills.

0de0d0f29945574b.description: Role Profile: Job Title: Senior Geologist, Geology & Quality Control II Department: Technical Engineering & Project Management Job location: Al Baitha, Northern Frontier, Saudi Arabia Working hours: 8 hours Type of work : Full time Job post start date: 10/11/2026 Job post end date: 10/25/2026 Maaden Brief: Maaden, established in 1997, is one of the fastest-growing mining companies in the world and the largest multi-commodity mining and metals company in the Middle East. Plan and manage grade control drilling programs. Oversee sampling, QA/QC, and database integrity. Conduct production and grade reconciliation activities. Prepare geological reports, maps, and technical presentations. Coordinate with mining, drilling, and resource teams. Ensure resource quality and compliance with customer specifications. Production Overseeing the monthly, Weekly and daily grade control functions Act as the point of contact to the Mine and Refinery for all Geological issues that arise. Planning Mine production Forecast, Short- and Medium-term Planning Planning and Implementation of Grade Control drilling programs as per mine plan Budget & Reporting Participates in annual budget preparation, providing estimates on field and office expenses as well as new equipment required and maintenance. Coordinate requirements and regulations from Corporate Regulatory & Compliance with concerned departments within C&W. 0d5bd9c24891139f.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة يبحث مجمع الفليو الطبي عن طبيب أسنان عام للانضمام إلى فريقه في بريدة، القصيم. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان، ووضع خطط العلاج، وإجراء المعالجات السنية المختلفة، بالإضافة إلى متابعة تركيبات الأسنان ومعالجة التهابات اللثة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الفحص السريري للأسنان، وتحديد الصور الشعاعية اللازمة وتحليلها، وتشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان، ثم إعداد خطة علاجية متكاملة ببرنامج زمني محدد. تطبيق وتجهيز الحشوات السنية، ومعالجة القنوات اللبية، وتنظيف الأسنان وإزالة الرواسب الكلسية. تحديد احتياجات المريض من التعويضات السنية، وأخذ القياسات اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. فحص اللثة وتشخيص أمراضها، ومعالجة التهابات اللثة، وإجراء جراحات الفم الصغرى، ووصف العلاجات والأدوية المناسبة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال طب الأسنان. إعداد وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بطب الأسنان في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، مع ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء أداء جميع المهام. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة درجة البكالوريوس في طب الأسنان. خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال طب الأسنان العام. القدرة على تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان بدقة ووضع خطط علاج فعالة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل مع المرضى وتقديم الرعاية الصحية اللازمة. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مجمع الفليو الطبي بمدينة بريدة، القصيم. سيتم العمل ضمن فريق طبي متخصص يسعى لتقديم أفضل مستويات الرعاية الصحية للمرضى. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

0d126e107597114c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة بن هادي لتاجير السيارات عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في أبها، عسير. يتولى المحاسب مسؤولية إعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية، ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها، بالإضافة إلى إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف، ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بناءً على الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطورات العلمية والتقنية في المجال. إعداد وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. معرفة قوية بالمبادئ المحاسبية وإجراءات التدقيق المالي. القدرة على إعداد التقارير المالية والوثائق المحاسبية بدقة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية ودقة في التعامل مع الأرقام. القدرة على تنظيم وتوثيق المستندات المالية. مهارات تواصل فعالة للتعامل مع الجهات الداخلية والخارجية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والمساهمة في تطوير الإجراءات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل في مدينة أبها بمنطقة عسير، ضمن بيئة عمل منظمة تركز على الدقة والالتزام بالمعايير المحاسبية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال مراحل المقابلة.

0d999e7a2baba4c0.description: We are seeking an experienced Plant Labelling Officer to support the accurate identification, documentation, labelling, mapping, and interpretation of living plant collections within a Botanic Garden environment. Translate technical botanical and horticultural information into clear and accessible content. 0d7f0dffbfe4abcc.description: About MBRF and the Role MBRF is a global food company dedicated to nourishing lives through quality and innovation. We are seeking a Quality Assurance Inspector I GF to join our team in Makkah, with operations also in Jeddah. This full-time role is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience, offering an opportunity to contribute to quality assurance processes within a large-scale food production environment. Key Responsibilities Inspect raw materials, ingredients, and packaging before production issuance, verifying against established programs. Monitor and update pest control records, and manage the pest control service supplier. Collect various samples including raw materials, ingredients, packaging, air, water, and swabbing for internal lab analysis. Verify the effectiveness of cleaning procedures for production lines. Ensure adherence to quality procedures through process verification, visual observation, and other methods. Provide technical guidance to production staff on Critical Control Points (CCPs), covering their identification, location, control methods, timing, and rationale. Review records to confirm that corrective actions align with the quality program. Facilitate the implementation of quality programs and propose necessary adjustments. Advise on corrective actions when deviations are identified in the production process. Verify monitoring and fill verification records according to the planned schedule. Report non-conformities and recommend appropriate corrective actions. Support the implementation of the Food Safety & Quality Management system. Analyze Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS) for all site chemicals to ensure suitability. Liaise with external service providers such as pest control, cleaning, and laundry services. Assist external service providers in collecting lab samples on site. Conduct Quality Routes and other system-required checks. Deliver Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) training (refresher, induction) to employees, contractors, service providers, and visitors, along with other technical trainings. Provide field-specific training, as needed (*, Allergens, CCP). Maintain supplier approval documentation and other system-required records. Comply with BRF Sustainability Policy guidelines and contribute to the BRF Sustainability Plan by ensuring adherence to indicators and global ESG commitments. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Ability to understand and implement quality assurance procedures. Strong attention to detail and observational skills. Effective communication skills for technical guidance and reporting. Work Environment and Culture MBRF fosters a global, collaborative, and dynamic working environment. The company maintains a strong corporate culture with commitments to customers, employees, and the communities it serves. Employees can expect opportunities for vertical, horizontal, and cross-functional growth within the organization. 0db4c8efd3e404c7.description: About the Role The Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority is seeking a Refund Auditor to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves carrying out specific tasks independently under close supervision, contributing to operational tasks, and processing refund operations in line with established policies and procedures. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Review and study refund policies to ensure adherence to ZATCA’s rules, regulations, policies, and procedures, including refund limit utilization and risk control authorizations. Develop and update assessment templates and audit tools in accordance with operational procedures to facilitate customer request analysis and timely evaluation. Stay informed about industry developments and new tax practices adopted by taxpayers and businesses for incorporation into assessments and audit reviews. Maintain and update refund manuals, eligibility criteria, legal requirements, and supporting documents by taxpayer type, integrating them into computer-aided audit tools. Consolidate, categorize, and prioritize refund requests, sorting them by tax/industry type for dispatch to relevant audit teams. Review refund applications, examine the validity and completeness of legal and supporting documents prior to case assessment. Gather data for desk audits, communicate with stakeholders (account managers, taxpayers, banks, government entities) for information and clarifications, and consult legal functions for contractual structures. Research public news, articles, and databases to understand taxpayers’ business activities, including structure, size, process, and jurisdictions. Assess taxpayers’ financial status, income statements, and revenue streams against benchmarks to determine the appropriate assessment approach. Inspect taxpayer declarations, identify high-risk issues, detect non-compliant cases, and communicate with internal stakeholders to mitigate potential risks such as tax evasion. Consolidate legal and financial observations, evaluate them against pre-approved eligibility criteria, and recommend approval or rejection decisions. Manage the development of audit reports, including tax assessments, to determine taxpayers’ refund amounts. Develop lists of compliant taxpayers with accepted refunds and related amounts, submitting them to internal committees for payment release approvals. Monitor taxpayer objections and appeals, coordinating with Legal Affairs or AMANA to resolve disputes and provide clarifications on audit findings. Maintain and update refund operations systems and databases, ensuring audit findings are stored for data exchange with internal stakeholders and government agencies. Reporting and Support Draft refund audit reports, highlighting recommendations and conclusions with relevant evidence and supporting documents for revision and verification. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience. Ability to carry out specific tasks independently under close supervision. Strong analytical and research skills. Proficiency in drafting reports and documents. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority. The role involves working independently on specific tasks while being subject to close supervision.

0d8ab7a9f97a4a31.description: About the Role Siemens Energy is establishing the role of Head of Controlling (Factory Finance Controller) in Dammam, Eastern Region, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is crucial for supporting the strategic ramp-up of GIS factory operations at SG Dammam and ensuring the successful execution of bulk tender and open market orders. The role focuses on driving financial transparency, end-to-end manufacturing cost optimization, and robust governance within the Switchgears Asia business unit. Role Context and Objectives The Head of Controlling will concentrate on factory cost controlling and allocation, monthly internal controls monitoring under IFRS, and enhancing budgeting and forecasting quality. These core areas are designed to enable precise financial steering, risk mitigation, and operational efficiency across the manufacturing lifecycle. The position requires a strong background in industrial cost accounting, IFRS compliance, and financial leadership, with extensive experience in factory controlling within the energy or heavy manufacturing sector being highly preferred. Key Responsibilities Oversee end-to-end product manufacturing cost controlling, variance analysis, and cost allocation processes for the GIS factory in Dammam. Establish and monitor key manufacturing performance indicators (KPIs) to drive operational efficiency and cost optimization. Manage product costing, inventory valuation, and scrap/obsolescence controls within the factory environment. Drive the annual budgeting process and monthly financial forecasting cycles to improve accuracy and quality of financial steering. Analyze financial performance against targets, providing actionable insights and corrective recommendations to the plant management team. Strengthen, execute, and monitor internal financial controls on a monthly basis in strict compliance with IFRS and corporate guidelines. Lead audit preparations and coordinate with internal and external auditors to ensure clean compliance records for factory operations. Qualifications and Experience 8-10 years of relevant experience. Strong background in industrial cost accounting. Proficiency in IFRS compliance. Demonstrated financial leadership capabilities. Extensive experience in factory controlling within the energy or heavy manufacturing sector is highly preferred. About Siemens Energy Siemens Energy is an energy technology company with approximately 100,000 employees across more than 90 countries. The company develops future energy systems, aiming to meet global energy demand reliably and sustainably. Its technologies contribute to the energy transition and account for a significant portion of the world's electricity generation. Siemens Energy is committed to sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy, building on a 150-year legacy of innovation. Our Commitment to Diversity Siemens Energy values diversity, drawing strength from over 130 nationalities. The company fosters an inclusive environment that celebrates individual character, irrespective of ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. Siemens Energy is dedicated to energizing all of society without discrimination.

Develop and implement project HSE plans, safety regulations, and emergency response plans in strict accordance with local Saudi standards and codes. - Organize mandatory pre-entry safety induction, professional safety training, and regular emergency drills. These cover working at height, crane lifting operations, hot work, temporary power utilization, confined space operation, and deep foundation pit construction. Ensure full safety disclosure and certified operation of all on-site staff. - Conduct daily comprehensive site patrols to identify potential safety hazards in a timely manner. Issue hazard rectification notices, track the rectification process, and manage closed-loop safety procedures. Establish complete safety ledgers, focusing on risk control and supervision of high-risk construction procedures such as high-altitude operation, hoisting operation, deep foundation pit construction, temporary electricity use, and mechanical operation. - Supervise the construction behaviors of subcontractors, suppliers, and third-party personnel to ensure full compliance with Saudi local safety specifications and project HSE management requirements. Audit and verify the HSE construction plans, qualification certificates, and staff training records of all subcontractors. - Take charge of on-site occupational health management and medical support. Strictly implement PPE wearing specifications and occupational disease prevention measures. Manage and control high temperature, dust, and noise hazards at the construction site. Standardize the disposal process of construction waste, on-site dust, domestic sewage, and hazardous materials to meet local environmental compliance requirements. - Conduct on-site investigation of safety accidents and near-miss incidents. Analyze root causes of risks, formulate targeted rectification schemes and preventive measures, and complete relevant reports and file archiving. Independently compile HSE daily, weekly, and monthly reports, meeting minutes, and all compliance certification documents. - Actively liaise and communicate with the Saudi Ministry of Labor, municipal government, and relevant regulatory authorities. Ensure all project construction activities fully comply with Saudi Building Code (SBC), industrial specifications, and local environmental protection laws and regulations. Complete relevant approval and filing work. - Promote the construction of on-site safety culture. Organize safety assessment, safety publicity, and special HSE promotion activities continuously. Iterate and optimize the project HSE management system to reduce construction risks. Job Requirements: - Bachelor’s degree or above in Safety Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, or other related engineering majors. - At least 3 years of formal HSE management working experience in infrastructure, building construction, or municipal engineering projects. Candidates with Saudi Arabia or Middle East on-site construction experience are highly preferred. - Priority will be given to candidates holding Saudi government-approved safety certificates, OSHA, NEBOSH, ISO45001, and other authoritative safety certification qualifications. Familiarity with Saudi Building Code (SBC) and local project safety approval and filing processes is required. - Proficient in Microsoft Office software. Possess outstanding risk identification ability, on-site execution, and cross-department communication and coordination capabilities. Able to be stationed at the Dammam construction site for long-term on-site work. - Fluent in English (used as the daily working language). Arabic proficiency is a bonus. Strong sense of responsibility and pressure resistance, capable of independently judging and handling various on-site safety emergencies and abnormal situations.
